in_sanskrit.long_meaning: दुश (dush) - difficult, hard; यन्त (yant) - moving, going; धुस् (dhus) - valiant, heroic

in_marathi.name: Dushyant
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Dark, radiant, or glowing
in_marathi.long_meaning: Dushyant हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Dushyant is derived from the Sanskrit word ‘dus’ which means ‘dark’ and ‘shyanta’ which means ‘radiant’ or ‘glowing’. The name signifies someone who is dark in complexion but possesses a shining, radiant personality.
